document.title: Structured export specification
document.summary: A buildable plan for adding durable, inspectable exports without coupling product state to a presentation format.

blocks.title: Problem and outcome
blocks.html:
Users need a portable record of a completed analysis. The current screen can be printed, but its transient UI state is not a durable document contract.

The export should derive from the same normalized result data, remain readable without the application, and expose its provenance.

items.label: Selected
items.title: Structured document model
items.detail: Render normalized blocks into a portable shell. Consistent, testable, and format-independent.

items.label: Rejected
items.title: DOM snapshot
items.detail: Fast initially, but couples the export to transient UI state and application CSS.

items.label: Deferred
items.title: Server PDF service
items.detail: Useful later, but introduces infrastructure before the document contract is proven.
